context.description: Trusted root adapter supplies current session revision, effective brand, role/capabilities and source version. No tokens/keys/cookies.

read.description: Typed branded projection. Unknown/incomplete collections do not imply zero; rows unavailable=null.

beginMutation.description: Root binds the immutable intent to principal/brand/version and returns the journaled operation ID. Absence of adapter closes actions.

submit.description: Root alone authorizes and atomically executes the bound operation. UI does not reissue/replace an uncertain operation.

receipt.description: Read-only recovery of the SAME original operation after timeout/ACK loss/reload. No second dispatch.

Context.capabilities: typed action -> available boolean/reason; server rechecks every action
Context.pendingOperations: Root-owned journal read: unresolved operation references for current principal/brand; recover via receipt, never client persistence
Context.contextRevision: opaque server-bound revision for principal/session/effective brand/capabilities; passed as expectedContextRevision; any change invalidates old responses and actions

acceptanceBoundary: Fixtures/tests verify UI behavior only; real routes, authority, journal, database and business proof are issued/admitted by Root.

domainRules.attributionModels: last_click and last_non_direct are alternative models, not additive totals
domainRules.attributionOrders: not currently exposed by public payload; unavailable until Root admits separate DTO
domainRules.pieceRevenue: never fabricate post/order revenue from aggregate or UTM alone
domainRules.links: server validates destination/effective brand/surface/origin, record revision and operation binding
domainRules.archive: preserve historical identity; same URL does not silently reactivate

syncContract: sync({filters?}={}) -> Promise<void>: each explicit refresh rereads context and typed data; coalesce equivalent concurrent calls, discard outdated results; never submit a mutation
disposeContract: dispose() -> void: invalidate generation, remove listeners/timers; no backend mutation

resourceFields.attribution-order-if-admitted: only Root-admitted orderReference/model/amountMinor/source/window, no PII; unavailable before admission
